subject: Reschedule proposal: demo vs CTO travel delay / VP coverage
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@stellarsystems.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@stellarsystems.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 20:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick note — CTO's flight delayed, need to move Monday demo?

Hi Vivek,

Quick heads-up: our CTO (Ben Calder) just had his inbound flight delayed due to weather and now won't land until late Monday evening. He still wants to see the demo, but won't be able to join the original Monday 10:00am PT slot.

Two options from our side:
- Keep Monday but start at 11:30am PT so Ben can join for the last 30–40 minutes (he'll be on a hotel shuttle until ~11:00am).
- Move to Tuesday morning — Ben is fully available Tuesday 9:00–11:30am PT.

If neither works, we can have Elena (VP Product) join on Monday and Ben join separately for the follow-up. Sorry for the last-minute change — travel windows are fun.

Can you propose what would work on Redwood's side? We want the CTO in the room if possible but can be pragmatic.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, Stellar Systems
alex@stellarsystems.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 07:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick note — CTO's flight delayed, need to move Monday demo?

Thanks for the heads-up, Alex — appreciate the notice.

We can accommodate either of the options you outlined. Pragmatically, a couple of proposals from our side:
1) Keep Monday and slide to 11:30am PT as you suggested. Marissa can lead the first 40 minutes and do the deep architecture walkthrough; Ben joins at ~12:10pm PT for Q&A and then we wrap by 12:40pm. We can expand the agenda to highlight the CTO-level concerns first (KV cache behavior, SLA/fallback policy).
2) Move to Tuesday 9:00am PT for a full session with Ben present. That gives us more time for live perf profiling and a demo of the Dedicated routing behaviors.

If option 1 is preferred, Jordan will create a short technical appendix and Marissa will cover the beginning of the session. If option 2 is selected, we'll keep the original agenda and add a 20-minute section on rollout/fallback.

Either way, I can send a calendar update and attach an updated agenda. Let me know within the hour and I will update invites.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni

Marissa — could you own the first ~45 minutes and then hand off to Ben/your team for the rest? Focus on the high-level runbooks and SLA/fallback section first so Elena and I have that context ready when Ben joins.

If you can confirm, Vivek, please send an updated invite with the adjusted timing. Also, can you drop a short 1-page agenda and the runbook excerpt so I can prep?
